clue.text: Disappointment of group needing support

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people that belong together
to back someone is to support them

explanation.surface: A band let down because it needs backing reads as a sad little music-business story.
explanation.definitionFit: A setback is a reverse or check to progress, which is a disappointment.

clue.text: Leave the country — could be good in Dubai, say

indicators.note: in puts the letter for good inside the Gulf state

parts.note: Dubai is one example of an emirate

explanation.surface: Someone moving abroad imagines life could be good in Dubai.
explanation.definitionFit: To emigrate is to move permanently out of one's home nation.

clue.text: Feeling bad and playing the course well

definitions.meaning: second meaning: in golf, scoring fewer strokes than par, which is good

explanation.walkthrough: The joke is the contradiction: below par is poor in health but excellent on the golf course, where par is the expected score.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means off-colour generally, and literally under the standard stroke count in golf.

clue.text: Old criminal boarding helicopter is a lummox

indicators.note: boarding means getting on, so the rearranged letters go inside the aircraft

parts.note: chopper is slang for a helicopter

indicators.note: criminal means bent or wrong, so the letters of Old are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ageing crook climbing aboard a helicopter is clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: A clodhopper is a clumsy, awkward oaf, just as a lummox is.

clue.text: Slump on sofa at last for a story

parts.note: to sag is to slump

indicators.note: at last takes the final letter of the word sofa

explanation.surface: Collapsing on the sofa at the end of the day for a bedtime tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is a long story, originally a Norse heroic tale.

clue.text: Lad attending a classical piece of music

parts.note: a son is a lad, a male child
at means attending, as in at school

explanation.surface: A boy going to a classical concert.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonata is a classical composition for one or two instruments in several movements.

clue.text: Parking in it does upset bank

indicators.note: in puts the parking letter inside the rearranged letters
upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters of it does are rearranged

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Parking in it upsets a riverbank, a complaint about cars on the verge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' looks like a noun, a riverside or a lender, but it is the verb, to pay money in.
explanation.definitionFit: To bank money is to deposit it in an account.

clue.text: Sculptor needed in case of everything degrading

indicators.note: needed in puts the sculptor inside the two outer letters
the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters

parts.note: Auguste Rodin was the French sculptor of The Thinker

explanation.surface: A sculptor is required in case everything falls apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Eroding means wearing away gradually, and so degrading.

clue.text: Subversive type of bar to use criminally

indicators.note: acting criminally means acting wrongly, so the letters of the fodder are bent out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to misuse a bar, fittingly for a troublemaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A saboteur deliberately undermines things from within, the very model of a subversive person.

clue.text: Edge around cat to get seat at the rear

indicators.note: around here means turned around, so the word for edge is read backwards

parts.note: a lip is the edge of a cup or crater
a lion is a big cat

explanation.surface: A motorcyclist edging round a big cat to reach the back seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pillion is the passenger seat behind the rider on a motorcycle.

clue.text: Suspicious soldier with no papers

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
taken as written
ID, identity documents, are papers

explanation.surface: A soldier without documents is naturally viewed with suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: Paranoid describes someone excessively mistrustful, an extreme of being suspicious.

clue.text: Favouring remedy to incorporate editor's way of working

parts.note: pro means in favour of

indicators.note: to incorporate means to take into its body, so the editor goes within the remedy

parts.note: a cure is a remedy
ED is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: Backing a fix that takes in the editor's own method.
explanation.definitionFit: A procedure is an established method or way of doing something.

clue.text: Good argument finally dealt with hotel development

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or argument

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word dealt

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A good row finally settled at a hotel counts as progress in a relationship.
explanation.definitionFit: Growth is an increase or advance, the same idea as development.

clue.text: Party after working once in a while

indicators.note: after places the party word behind the word for working

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
an occasion is a special event such as a party

explanation.surface: A party held after work happens now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: On occasion is an idiom meaning sometimes or from time to time.

clue.text: Destroying a cell, enter to provide defensive structure for castle

indicators.note: destroying wrecks the order of the letters in a cell, enter, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An invader wrecks a prison cell and storms into a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: To crenellate is to furnish a wall with battlements, the notched defences of a castle.

clue.text: Smoker invested in inhalant expecting returns

indicators.note: returns says the hidden letters are read backwards
invested in means placed inside, so the letters sit within these words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone puts money into an inhalant hoping for a return on it.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Smoker invested' as the definition, but 'invested in' is the signal that the letters lie within 'inhalant expecting'; 'Smoker' alone defines the volcano. ANTE read backwards gives ETNA.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the Sicilian volcano, which smokes, so a smoker in crossword fashion.

clue.text: Act on behalf of engineers attending

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
to be present is to be attending

explanation.surface: A spokesperson acts for engineers who turn up.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent someone is to speak or act as their agent.

clue.text: Worried tense Democrat supporting currency

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue puts the Democrat underneath, so after the currency

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
the rouble is the currency of Russia

explanation.surface: A nervous American politician props up a shaky currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Troubled means anxious or disturbed, the same as worried.

clue.text: Suitable priest with holy book needing different opening

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Old Testament book of Samuel

indicators.note: needing a different opening means the first letter of the holy book is swapped for another

parts.note: the Bible is the holy book

explanation.surface: A clergyman's scripture needs a fresh first page to be fit.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue does not name the new first letter; the crossing letters and the definition settle that it becomes G.
explanation.definitionFit: Eligible means qualified or fit to be chosen, so suitable.

clue.text: Screen boy up for outrage

parts.note: to screen is to scan, as with a medical or security check

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A boy facing a screening test turns into a public outcry.
explanation.definitionFit: A scandal is an event causing public outrage.

clue.text: New Year's Day rise for caretaker

parts.note: New Year's Day is January 1, written JAN I with the Roman numeral
a tor is a rocky hill or rise, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: A New Year's Day climb up a hill for a building's keeper.
explanation.definitionFit: A janitor is a building's caretaker, who cleans and maintains it.

clue.text: Right to replace son in only part

indicators.note: to replace says the first letter goes in where the second one was

parts.note: sole means only, as in the sole survivor
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A right to take the place of one's son in a single part, like an inheritance.
explanation.definitionFit: A role is a part played by an actor.

clue.text: Sort of green plan to recycle

parts.note: to chart a course is to plan it
to reuse something is to recycle it

explanation.surface: An environmentalist's scheme to recycle, which is a green policy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' looks environmental beside 'recycle', but here it is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Chartreuse is a yellowish-green colour, named after the liqueur.

clue.text: They may be worn in absentia, rashly

indicators.note: in signals the letters lie within the phrase absentia, rashly

explanation.surface: Things perhaps put on hastily by someone not present, a nod to the legal phrase in absentia.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiaras are jewelled headbands, worn by royalty or brides.

clue.text: Bound to take over room

indicators.note: to take means the outer word holds the other one within it

parts.note: a lunge is a sudden forward leap or bound
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: Someone is obliged to take charge of a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' reads as obliged, but it is the noun meaning a leap.
explanation.definitionFit: A lounge is a sitting room in a house or hotel.

clue.text: Annoying person one's put in shade

indicators.note: put in places the letters for one's inside the word for shade

parts.note: a nuance is a subtle shade of meaning or colour
one is I, and one's is I'S, the letters IS

explanation.surface: Someone stuck in the shade, perhaps an irritant shoved out of the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuisance is a pest, someone who causes irritation.

clue.text: Peaceful state west of Mongolia

indicators.note: west of in a down clue puts the state before the other letter

parts.note: Cal is a short form of California, the US state
M stands for Mongolia here, the country's initial used as a loose abbreviation

explanation.surface: A tranquil country lying west of Mongolia.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm means tranquil and undisturbed, so peaceful.

clue.text: Peer needs order for location of stud

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm
the OBE is the Order of the British Empire, a British honour

explanation.surface: A nobleman needing an honour to complete his status.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stud' tempts towards horses or shirts, but here it is an earring stud.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud earring is worn through the earlobe, so that is where the stud is located.

clue.text: Moving abroad, the French must be lovely

indicators.note: moving shifts the letters of abroad around into a new order

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: Relocating abroad, a French life must be delightful.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable means charming, delightful, inspiring affection.

clue.text: Notices found in Scottish river area and lake

indicators.note: found in puts the notices inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Aberdeenshire
ads are advertisements, public notices

explanation.surface: Signs posted near a Scottish river and loch.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dead Sea is in fact a landlocked salt lake between Israel and Jordan.
